Contract Generator.contract:
Contract AirportSystem::createStaff(id: Integer,name: String,pswd: String,phone: String,role: Integer,bossid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		obsStaff: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id),
		bossStaff: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = bossid)
	precondition:
		bossStaff.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		if obsStaff.oclIsUndefined() 
		then let ob: Staff in
		ob.oclIsNew() and
		Staff.allInstance()->includes(ob) and
		ob.Id = id and
		ob.Name = name and
		ob.Password = pswd and
		ob.Phone = phone and
		ob.Role = role and
		ob.Boss = bossStaff 
		else obsStaff.Boss = bossStaff 
		endif 
}
